name: env-cap-example-application
description: Minimal end-to-end example: capability-owned env.schema.ts files, a generated contract, and validateEnv() at startup.

scripts.docs:reports: npm run docs && tsx scripts/generate-docs/run.ts && tsx scripts/rotation-log/run.ts
scripts.check: env-cap --include src/env.ts --location src/generated/env.manifest.ts --evidence docs/env.evidence.json --check && tsx scripts/generate-docs/check.ts
